titulo: NASA’s Curiosity Looks Back After Reaching Elevation Milestone
cuerpo: Description NASA’s Curiosity Mars rover captured this view looking back at the floor of Gale Crater, with the crater’s rim visible in the distance, on Sept. 5, 2026, the 5,006th Martian day, or sol, of the mission.
